purpose: Clinical research on within-person asthma trajectories. Statistics are not enough because we must link repeated measurements within each person over time.
question: Provide pseudonymised conditions and BMI values for adults with asthma who have at least one BMI value.
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Asthma = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with J45.
Cohort = adults with asthma who have at least one BMI value (LOINC 39156-5).
Report the size of the cohort you would make available.
